title: incident-bot: add on-call autodiagnostics helpers and SLO-toolkit integration
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: on-call runbooks and automated diagnostics are frequently referenced in incidents but lack consistent helper utilities across incident-bot and the slo-toolkit. This PR adds a small library of on-call autodiagnostics helpers, ties incident-bot runbook suggestions to SLO context, and surfaces prioritized quicklinks for responders. Changes: 1) incident-bot: new autodiag_helpers module that standardizes runbook link scoring, SLO context enrichment, and quicklink prioritization; 2) slo-toolkit: introduced a lightweight SLO metadata adapter that exposes service-level hints (owner, escalation, playbooks) to the incident-bot; 3) runbooks: added schema validation and compact metadata fields to improve suggestion fidelity; 4) console/docs: updated oncall runbook guide and examples. Checklist: - [x] Implement autodiag_helpers API and unit tests - [x] Wire SLO metadata adapter with incident-bot plugin - [x] Add end-to-end acceptance test in perf-canary harness - [x] Update docs and runbook examples - [x] Feature flag rollout behind incident_bot.autodiag_v2 Notes: This is intended as a backward-compatible enhancement. The feature is gated by a feature-flag and defaults to off. Rollout plan: enable for internal staging, run canary on low-traffic service, then gradual rollout to SRE-managed customers. Backwards compatibility: existing runbook links remain supported. Related: ENG-4892 (autodiag helpers), SRE-112 (oncall UX improvements), SUP-7421 (customer report referencing missing runbook context).

Asha Patel (reply): Added negative test for missing SLO metadata and wrapped plugin registration behind incident_bot.autodiag_v2 feature flag.

SLO-toolkit: expose SLO metadata adapter for runbook enrichment
Docs: updated oncall runbook guide with quicklink examples
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind incident_bot.autodiag_v2; enable in staging first. Watch for 5xx spikes in services with large runbook payloads and monitor incident-bot latency. Metrics: incident_bot.runbook_suggestions.latency, incident_bot.quicklinks.rank_latency.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover scoring and SLO fallthrough scenarios. Added an e2e canary that simulates oncall flow and validates prioritized quicklinks. Staging canary ran for 48h with no errors.
